_about: MIS showcase: the small table that makes the demo shops differ (tools/sim-load.cjs --profile <name>; read by tools/sim-plan.cjs historyDays). scale = a multiple of the data file's daily takings (whole dollars); slide_pct = a struggling shop's yearly slide; cost_pct = the cost of goods as a share of the month's walk-in takings, split over the suppliers (the trade mix); pay_ratio = the share of bills 30+ days old it pays on day 27 (under 1 = bills left owing); cust_ratio = the share its credit customer pays on day 25; bank_diff_minor = a signed bank statement for the last closed month that differs from the books by that amount (AUD cents). All AUD and DEMO. 'grocer' is the shop tools/seed/mis-history-expected.json is hand-written for.
